recommended_next_discriminator.first: Read-only/direct binary audit of the selected CO2 main records and their exact LNFL/TAPE3 companion records, keyed by trace identities (molecule/isotope/VNU/flag/sequence); validate raw record bytes -> RDLIN decoded companion -> LNCOR1 interpolated YI/GI/SPPSP. Preserve all unrelated records and original line ordering.
nonclaims: No source evidence here proves TAPE3 corruption or a reader defect.
A mathematically negative R3 contribution is not by itself proof that line coupling or the reference is invalid.
Do not convert the NOCPL control into an accuracy reference.
No support-limit change, tolerance change, or physical-validity conclusion is supported.
recommended_next_discriminator.second_if_record_path_matches: For only the traced target R3 cells, enumerate all contributing updates and report support/carry geometry and each line’s ALFV/HWF3/ALFMAX status, JMIN/JMAX, J3/IZ3/ZF3L and PANEL shifts. recommended_next_discriminator.why_first: Current trace already localizes negative increments to the coupling operand; confirming the representation/association feeding that operand tests a potentially consequential interface before investigating finite support.

facts: INPUT_BLOCK stores VNU as REAL(8), while SP/ALFA/EPP/HWHM/TMPALF/PSHIFT are REAL(4), MOL and IFLG are INTEGER(4) (struct_types.f90 34-43).

Both RDLIN and RDLNFL branch on IFLG: nonnegative MOL is copied as integer; negative-IFLG MOL bits are TRANSFERred to REAL(4), promoted to REAL(8), then transferred into wider storage. Thus negative-IFLG companion data is deliberately encoded in the MOL slot and must not be decoded as a molecule identifier.

The reader builds IOUT only from records with IFLG>=0 (RDLIN 840-850; RDLNFL analogous at 3490-3499), so companion records are consumed to populate interpolation arrays but are not main absorption lines.
source_findings.interpretation: This is a real precision/representation boundary worth auditing against the selected raw TAPE3 bytes and the values delivered to LNCOR1. Source alone does not show corruption; transfer is explicitly intentional.

facts: LNFL SHRINK writes a main line, then appends companion line records when the main IFLG is >=1; IFLG=5 appends an additional self-coupling companion (1057-1116).

The line parser normalizes a negative input coupling flag to its absolute value and maintains IFLGM1 state (1646-1679). For flag 5 it reads a foreign coupling row, sets IFLGM1=1 for the next self-coupling row; the subsequent branch reads coupling fields and resets IFLGM1=0 (1775-1814).
RDLIN uses the emitted IFLG and companion sequence; LNCOR1 consumes the companion-interpolated A/B values for coupling (oprop 1036-1061).
source_findings.interpretation: An exact selected main-plus-companion record audit is more discriminating next than changing line-support limits: it can verify identity, flag/state sequence, embedded REAL(4) payload bits, and final LNCOR1 YI/GI inputs for the traced lines.

facts: LNCOR1 computes ALFV, floors it at DV, caps it at ALFMAX, and skips a line when HWF3*ALFV+VNU<VFT (1107-1123).

CNVFNV constructs ZSLOPE, ZINT, JMIN/JMAX and the R3 shift; base line updates use R3(J3)+STRF3*F3(IZ3) and coupling updates use R3(J3)+STRF3*F3(IZ3)*ZF3L (1284-1316, 1322-1349). The finite update range is JMIN1..JMAX1.

The trace report verifies actual negative crossings in the target R3 window from CO2 coupling increments; it reports GI strength multipliers equal to 1, positive continuum increment, and zero XS/LBLF4 increment for those selected accounting points.
source_findings.interpretation: Support limits and panel mapping are a second-stage question after record/YI/GI provenance. A bounded support audit should retain every line update mapped into the four target R3 points plus line-center, widths, HWF3, ALFMAX-capped ALFV, ZSLOPE, JMIN/JMAX, J3, IZ3, ZF3L, and PANEL/VFT identity. This would test truncation/mapping, not certify physical validity.
